_note: Draft Swahili strings - must be reviewed by a native-speaking translator before go-live (SYS-06).
invite.supplier: {buyer} amekualika kwenye Mapema ili ulipwe mapema kwa ankara zilizoidhinishwa. Jiunge: {link}
invite.user: Umealikwa kwenye Mapema. Fungua akaunti yako: {link}
invoice.eligible: Ankara {invoice} kutoka {buyer} imethibitishwa. Sasa unaweza kuomba malipo ya mapema.
advance.approved: Malipo ya awali kwa ankara {invoice} yameidhinishwa, yanasubiri kutolewa.
advance.funded: Mapema imetuma {amount} kwa ankara {invoice} kwenye akaunti yako inayoishia {last4}. Kumb. {ref}.
advance.release_failed: Hatukuweza kulipa ankara {invoice}: {reason}. Timu yetu itawasiliana nawe.
notice.assignment: Taarifa ya uhamisho: ankara {invoice} ({amount}) kutoka {supplier} imehamishiwa Mapema. Lipa kiasi chote tarehe {due} kwenye akaunti {account}.
payment.receipt.buyer: Risiti: tumepokea {amount} tarehe {date} kwa ankara {invoice}. Asante.
settlement.balance_proposed: Mnunuzi wako amelipa ankara {invoice}. Salio lako la {amount} linatolewa leo.
payout.balance_sent: Mapema imetuma salio lako la {amount} kwa ankara {invoice}. Kumb. {ref}.
late.d1_reminder: Kumbukumbu: ankara {invoice} ({amount}) ilitakiwa kulipwa tarehe {due}. Tafadhali lipa kwenye akaunti {account}.
dispute.opened: Mnunuzi amewasilisha mgogoro kuhusu ankara {invoice}. Kagua kwenye lango la wafanyakazi.
dsr.received: Ombi jipya la mhusika wa data {ref}. Muda wa kisheria unaendelea.
recon.break: Ulinganisho wa hesabu wa {date} una tofauti. Kagua kabla ya kutoa malipo.
advance.recourse: Ankara {invoice} sasa iko chini ya urejeshaji. Tafadhali wasiliana na Mapema.
shortfall.opened.supplier: Mnunuzi wako amelipa {paid} kwa ankara {invoice} ya {invoice_amount}. Mapema imelipwa; mnunuzi bado anadaiwa {amount} na wewe. Tafadhali fuatilia moja kwa moja - malipo yoyote zaidi atakayofanya kwenye akaunti ya makusanyo yatapelekwa kwako.
shortfall.opened.buyer: Ankara {invoice}: umelipa {paid} kati ya {invoice_amount}. Bado unadaiwa {amount} na msambazaji wako. Lipa kwenye akaunti yako ya kawaida ya makusanyo ukitaja {invoice}.
shortfall.settled.supplier: Mnunuzi sasa amelipa salio lililobaki la ankara {invoice}. Hakuna kingine unachodaiwa kwa ankara hii.
